 try{for(let r=0;r<2;r++){A.push(await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false}));added=perfGrowth(true);await perfWait(1500);B.push(await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false}));perfGrowth(false);await perfWait(1500)}}finally{perfGrowth(false)}
 const m=(a,f)=>perfR(perfAvg(a.map(f)),1),d=(a,b)=>a>0?perfR((b-a)/a*100,1):0;
 const base={fps:m(A,x=>x.fps),frameAvg:m(A,x=>x.frameMs.avg),frameP95:m(A,x=>x.frameMs.p95),jsAvg:m(A,x=>x.jsMs.avg)},grown={fps:m(B,x=>x.fps),frameAvg:m(B,x=>x.frameMs.avg),frameP95:m(B,x=>x.frameMs.p95),jsAvg:m(B,x=>x.jsMs.avg)};
 return{offscreenBefore:offscreen,added,windows:'A/B/A/B × '+seconds+' s',base,grown,deltaFramePct:d(base.frameAvg,grown.frameAvg),deltaJsPct:d(base.jsAvg,grown.jsAvg),limitPct:5,pass:d(base.frameAvg,grown.frameAvg)<=5}}

function perfAddCars(n,slotOk,tag){const slots=TRAFFIC_SEED_SLOTS.filter(id=>{const e=byEdge[id];return e&&byNode[e.a]&&byNode[e.b]&&slotOk(e)}),add=[];
 for(let i=0;i<n&&slots.length;i++){const edgeId=slots[i%slots.length],lap=Math.floor(i/slots.length),spec=pickTrafficAsset(i),dirSign=(i+lap)%2?1:-1,t=.1+((i*.37+lap*.21)%.8),e=byEdge[edgeId],lanePref=i%2,lane=e?.cls==='main'?i%3:e?.cls==='arterial'?lanePref:0,p=trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane);
  const v={id:tag+(i+1),asset:spec.asset,ref:spec.ref,kind:spec.kind,label:spec.label||'רכב',edgeId,dirSign,t,lane,lanePref,laneTarget:lane,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,speed:0,targetSpeed:95+(i%4)*10,wait:false,hop:i,stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,runKey:null,c2:null,perfGrowth:true};TRAFFIC_CARS.push(v);add.push(v)}
 try{CORE2_STATS.placeFix=true}catch{}return add}
function perfRemove(list,arr){if(!list)return 0;const ids=new Set(list.map(v=>v.id));for(let i=arr.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(ids.has(arr[i].id))arr.splice(i,1);return list.length}
async function perfDensityTest(seconds=6){
 const inView=TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(v=>!v.c5&&perfInView(v.x,v.y,0)).length+BUS_VEHICLES.filter(v=>perfInView(v.x,v.y,0)).length,A=[],B=[];let added=0;
 try{for(let r=0;r<2;r++){A.push(await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false}));const l=perfAddCars(inView,e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b];return perfInView((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2,-60)},'PERF-DENS-');added=l.length;PERF.dens=l;await perfWait(1500);B.push(await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false}));perfRemove(PERF.dens,TRAFFIC_CARS);PERF.dens=null;await perfWait(1500)}}finally{perfRemove(PERF.dens,TRAFFIC_CARS);PERF.dens=null}
 const m=(a,f)=>perfR(perfAvg(a.map(f)),1),d=(a,b)=>a>0?perfR((b-a)/a*100,1):0;const base={fps:m(A,x=>x.fps),frameAvg:m(A,x=>x.frameMs.avg),jsAvg:m(A,x=>x.jsMs.avg)},dense={fps:m(B,x=>x.fps),frameAvg:m(B,x=>x.frameMs.avg),jsAvg:m(B,x=>x.jsMs.avg)};
 return{inViewBefore:inView,added,windows:'A/B/A/B × '+seconds+' s',base,dense,deltaFramePct:d(base.frameAvg,dense.frameAvg),deltaJsPct:d(base.jsAvg,dense.jsAvg),headroomFps:dense.fps}}



const PERF_STRESS_RAIL=[190e3,380e3,570e3,760e3];
function perfStress(on){
 if(on){if(PERF.stress)return PERF.stress.info;const cars=TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(v=>!v.c5&&!v.perfGrowth).length,peds=[];
  const add=perfAddCars(cars,()=>true,'PERF-STRESS-');for(let i=0,n=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.length;i<n;i++){const q=NPC_PEDESTRIANS[i],c={...q,id:'PERF-STRESS-PED-'+(i+1),targetId:null,inCrosswalk:null,ghost:0,wait:false,perfGrowth:true};NPC_PEDESTRIANS.push(c);peds.push(c)}
  const f0=drawFreightTrains;drawFreightTrains=function(now){f0(now);const v=portView(260);for(const dk of PERF_STRESS_RAIL)for(const q of rlSnap(now+dk))for(const c of q.cars){if(c.x>G76_VIS_X||c.x<v.x0-260||c.x>v.x1+260||c.y<v.y0-260||c.y>v.y1+260)continue;portDrawStock(ctx,{asset:c.car.asset,variant:c.car.variant||0,load:flWagonLoad(q.S,c.car,now+dk)},{x:c.x,y:c.y,heading:c.heading},now/1000)}try{__rlSnapT=null}catch{}};
  PERF.stress={cars:add,peds,f0,info:{roadVehiclesAdded:add.length,pedestriansAdded:peds.length,extraFreightConsists:PERF_STRESS_RAIL.length,notSimulated:'aircraft / ships / passenger trains / port-truck volumes of GATE-76…82'}};return PERF.stress.info}
 if(!PERF.stress)return null;const S=PERF.stress;perfRemove(S.cars,TRAFFIC_CARS);perfRemove(S.peds,NPC_PEDESTRIANS);drawFreightTrains=S.f0;PERF.stress=null;return true}
async function perfStressTest(seconds=10){
 const base=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false});let info=null,st=null;try{info=perfStress(true);await perfWait(2500);st=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:true})}finally{perfStress(false)}
 return{...info,base:{fps:base.fps,frameAvg:base.frameMs.avg,p95:base.frameMs.p95,jsAvg:base.jsMs.avg},stress:{fps:st.fps,frameAvg:st.frameMs.avg,p95:st.frameMs.p95,p99:st.frameMs.p99,jsAvg:st.jsMs.avg,kinds:st.kinds,over50:st.over50,over100:st.over100,heapMB:st.heapMB}}}

function perfGpuInfo(){
 if(PERF.gpu)return PERF.gpu;let renderer='',vendor='',webgl=false;
 try{const c=document.createElement('canvas'),gl=c.getContext('webgl')||c.getContext('experimental-webgl');if(gl){webgl=true;const ext=gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');renderer=ext?gl.getParameter(ext.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER);vendor=ext?gl.getParameter(ext.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.VENDOR);try{gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext()}catch{}}}catch{}
 const soft=/swiftshader|llvmpipe|softpipe|software|basic render|microsoft basic/i.test(renderer);
 PERF.gpu={webgl,renderer:String(renderer||''),vendor:String(vendor||''),accelerated:webgl&&!!renderer&&!soft,
  note:!webgl?'WebGL לא זמין — כנראה שהאצת הגרפיקה כבויה':soft?'רינדור תוכנה — האצת הגרפיקה כבויה: Chrome → הגדרות → מערכת → "השתמש בהאצת גרפיקה כשהיא זמינה"':'האצת הגרפיקה פעילה'};
 return PERF.gpu}

async function perfRun(name,{seconds=12,profSeconds=8,opsSeconds=3,warm=3,cold=3,ops=true,profile=true}={}){
 PERF.busy=true;try{const info=await perfScenario(name);
  
  const c0=cold>0?await perfMeasure(cold,{profile:false,minFrames:3}):null;await perfWait(Math.max(0,warm-cold)*1000+1000);
  let clean=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false,ops:false}),inval=perfInvalid(clean),retried=null;if(inval){retried=inval;perfHudStatus('מדידה לא תקפה ('+inval+') — מודד שוב פעם אחת');await perfWait(2000);clean=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false,ops:false});inval=perfInvalid(clean)}let prof=null,o=null;
  if(profile)prof=await perfMeasure(profSeconds,{profile:true,ops:false});
  let oi=null,gq=null;if(ops){try{g77GpuReset()}catch(e){}let q=null;try{q=await perfMeasure(opsSeconds,{profile:false,ops:true})}finally{try{gq=g77GpuTake(q)}catch(e){}}o=q.ops;oi=q.load?q.load.drawImagePerFrame:null}    
  const r={...info,cold:c0?{fps:c0.fps,maxMs:c0.frameMs.max,over50:c0.over50,over100:c0.over100}:null,fps:clean.fps,low1Fps:clean.low1Fps,frameMs:clean.frameMs,jsMs:clean.jsMs,sim:clean.sim,over33:clean.over33,over50:clean.over50,over100:clean.over100,stallsPerMin:clean.stallsPerMin,gcEstimate:clean.gcEstimate,heapMB:clean.heapMB,canvasMB:clean.canvasMB,longTasks:clean.longTasks,stalls:clean.stalls,ops:o,load:clean.load?{...clean.load,drawImagePerFrame:oi}:null,frames:clean.frames,gd:gq,valid:!inval,invalid:inval||undefined,retried:retried||undefined};
  if(prof){r.cats=prof.cats;r.kinds=prof.kinds;r.profiledJsMs=prof.jsMs;r.topFunctions=prof.topFunctions.slice(0,12);r.budget=perfBudget(prof.kinds,prof.jsMs.avg)}
  return r}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
function perfBudget(k,js){const over=PERF_KINDS.filter(x=>k[x]>PERF_BUDGET[x]),margin=perfR(PERF_BUDGET.frame-js,1);return{ok:!over.length&&margin>=PERF_BUDGET.margin,over,marginMs:margin}}
const PERF_MODE=/[#&]webgl\b/.test(location.hash)?(/[#&]pq\b/.test(location.hash)?'webgl+pq':'webgl'):(/[#&]pq\b/.test(location.hash)?'pq':'normal'),PERF_MODE_HE={normal:'רגיל',webgl:'עם WebGL',pq:'עם pq','webgl+pq':'WebGL + pq',all:'הכול ברצף'};
const PERF_LAST_KEY='turbo_city_bench_last_v1'+(PERF_MODE==='normal'?'':'_'+PERF_MODE),PERF_SEQ_KEY='turbo_city_bench_seq_v1',PERF_SEQ=['normal','webgl'];    
function perfLastReport(){try{const r=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LAST_KEY)||'null');return r&&r.scenarios?r:null}catch{return null}}
function perfCompare(cur,prev){
 if(!prev)return null;const out={build:prev.build,date:prev.date,scenarios:{}};
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cur.scenarios)){const p=prev.scenarios[k];if(!p||!p.frameMs||!v.frameMs)continue;if(v.invalid||p.invalid){out.scenarios[k]={invalid:true,why:v.invalid||('המדידה הקודמת: '+p.invalid)};continue}const d=perfR((v.frameMs.p95-p.frameMs.p95)/Math.max(.1,p.frameMs.p95)*100,1);out.scenarios[k]={p95Before:p.frameMs.p95,p95Now:v.frameMs.p95,deltaPct:d,regression:d>10,fpsBefore:p.fps,fpsNow:v.fps}}
 return out}
async function perfBenchmark({seconds=12,longMinutes=1,route=PERF_ROUTE,growth=true,pan=true,stress=true,onStep=null}={}){
 if(PERF.busy)return null;const T0=performance.now(),saved={mapQa:State.mapQa,x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};
 const out={tool:'Turbo City PERF-04 benchmark v1',mode:PERF_MODE,build:BUILD,version:VER,gate:ACTIVE_GATE,ua:navigator.userAgent,viewport:innerWidth+'×'+innerHeight,dpr,screen:screen.width+'×'+screen.height,
  benchMode:!!window.__TC_BENCH,seed:window.__TC_BENCH?.seed??null,gpu:perfGpuInfo(),date:new Date().toISOString(),budgetMs:PERF_BUDGET,scenarios:{}};
 const steps=route.length+(growth?2:0)+(pan?2:0)+(stress?1:0)+(longMinutes>0?1:0);let k=0;const step=t=>{k++;perfHudStatus(`Benchmark ${k}/${steps}: ${t}`);onStep&&onStep(k,steps,t)};
 try{for(const n of route){step(PERF_SCN[n].label);out.scenarios[n]=await perfRun(n,{seconds})
   if(n==='city'&&growth){step('מבחן גדילה — הכפלת הרכבים שמחוץ למסך');PERF.busy=true;try{out.growth=await perfGrowthTest(6)}finally{PERF.busy=false}
    step('מבחן צפיפות ×2 בתוך המסך');PERF.busy=true;try{out.density=await perfDensityTest(6)}finally{PERF.busy=false}}}
  if(pan){step('מעבר בין Chunks — מסלול מצלמה, פעם ראשונה (cold)');PERF.busy=true;try{out.panCold=await perfPathRun();step('מעבר בין Chunks — אותו מסלול שוב (warm)');out.panWarm=await perfPathRun()}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
  if(stress){step('מצב Stress לעתיד — כמויות סוף התוכנית (חלקי)');PERF.busy=true;try{await perfScenario('extreme');await perfWait(2000);out.stress=await perfStressTest(10)}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
  if(longMinutes>0){step('ריצה ארוכה: '+longMinutes+' דק׳');PERF.busy=true;try{await perfScenario('long');await perfWait(2000);const m=await perfMeasure(longMinutes*60,{profile:false});out.long={minutes:longMinutes,fps:m.fps,low1Fps:m.low1Fps,frameMs:m.frameMs,over50:m.over50,over100:m.over100,stallsPerMin:m.stallsPerMin,heapMB:m.heapMB,canvasMB:m.canvasMB,gcEstimate:m.gcEstimate,longTasks:m.longTasks,stalls:m.stalls}}finally{PERF.busy=false}}}
 finally{PERF.timeOfs=0;if(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined')SIM_BENCH_OFS=SIM_RAIL_BASE;if(State.mapQa!==saved.mapQa)toggleMapQa();Camera.x=saved.x;Camera.y=saved.y;Camera.zoom=saved.zoom;perfFrameHook(false)}
 out.totalS=perfR((performance.now()-T0)/1000,0);out.memory={heapMB:perfHeap()!=null?Math.round(perfHeap()):null,canvasMB:perfCanvasMem(),limitMB:500};
 const prev=perfLastReport();if(prev&&prev.build!==BUILD)out.compare=perfCompare(out,prev);else if(prev&&prev.compareBase&&prev.compareBase.build!==BUILD)out.compare=perfCompare(out,prev.compareBase);
 try{const keep={...out,compareBase:prev&&prev.build!==BUILD?{build:prev.build,date:prev.date,scenarios:prev.scenarios}:(prev?.compareBase||null)};localStorage.setItem(PERF_LAST_KEY,JSON.stringify(keep))}catch{}
 PERF.report=out;perfHudStatus('הסתיים — '+Object.entries(out.scenarios).map(([k,v])=>k+' '+v.fps+' FPS').join(' · '));perfHudRender();return out}

function perfReportText(r){
 if(!r)return'';const L=[];L.push(`Turbo City · Benchmark (PERF-04) · ${PERF_MODE_HE[r.mode||'normal']||r.mode} · ${r.build} · ${r.date}`);
 L.push(`מסך ${r.viewport} · dpr ${r.dpr} · ${r.gpu.accelerated?'GPU: '+r.gpu.renderer:'GPU: '+r.gpu.note+(r.gpu.renderer?' ('+r.gpu.renderer+')':'')}`);
 L.push(`${navigator.userAgent.match(/(Chrome|Firefox|Edg|Safari)\/[\d.]+/g)?.join(' ')||navigator.userAgent}`);
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(r.scenarios)){const b=v.kinds?` · ציור ${v.kinds.render} · סימולציה ${v.kinds.sim} · ממשק ${v.kinds.ui} · שונות ${v.kinds.misc} ms`:'';
  L.push(`${k}: ${v.invalid?'⚠ לא תקפה ('+v.invalid+') · ':''}${v.retried&&!v.invalid?'(נמדד שוב: '+v.retried+') · ':''}${v.fps} FPS (1% low ${v.low1Fps}) · פריים ${v.frameMs.avg}/${v.frameMs.p95}/${v.frameMs.p99} ms (ממוצע/p95/p99) · max ${v.frameMs.max} · >50ms ${v.over50} · >100ms ${v.over100} · JS ${v.jsMs.avg}${b}${v.ops?' · ציור '+v.ops.avg+' פעולות':''}${v.gd?' · לכרטיס המסך: '+(typeof g77GpuText==='function'?g77GpuText(v.gd):v.gd.ops+' פעולות'):''}${v.load?` · לפריים: bitmaps חדשים ${v.load.newBitmapsPerFrame}, ספרייטים חדשים ${v.load.newFamiliesPerFrame}, drawImage ${v.load.drawImagePerFrame??'—'}`:''}${v.heapMB?' · heap '+v.heapMB.max+'MB':''}${v.cold?` · כניסה ראשונה: max ${v.cold.maxMs} ms, >50ms ${v.cold.over50}, >100ms ${v.cold.over100}`:''}`)
  if(v.stalls&&v.stalls.n)L.push(`  ${k} — פריימים מעל 50ms: ${v.stalls.n} · ${Object.entries(v.stalls.by).map(([a,b])=>(PERF_STALL_HE[a]||a)+' '+b).join(' · ')} · הארוך: ${v.stalls.top[0].dt} ms (JS ${v.stalls.top[0].js}, SIM ${v.stalls.top[0].simMs}/${v.stalls.top[0].steps} צעדים${v.stalls.top[0].simMs>4?` (תנועה ${v.stalls.top[0].simW} · נמל ${v.stalls.top[0].simFl} · שדה ${v.stalls.top[0].simAo})`:''}, אריחים ${v.stalls.top[0].tileMs} ms${v.stalls.top[0].fam?`, ספרייטים חדשים ${v.stalls.top[0].fam} (${v.stalls.top[0].famMs} ms)`:''})`);}
 if(r.growth)L.push(`גדילה: +${r.growth.added} רכבים מחוץ למסך → פריים ${r.growth.deltaFramePct>0?'+':''}${r.growth.deltaFramePct}% (סף 5%) · JS ${r.growth.deltaJsPct>0?'+':''}${r.growth.deltaJsPct}%`);
 if(r.density)L.push(`צפיפות ×2 בתוך המסך: +${r.density.added} רכבים → ${r.density.dense.fps} FPS (לפני ${r.density.base.fps}) · פריים ${r.density.deltaFramePct>0?'+':''}${r.density.deltaFramePct}%`);
 for(const [lab,p] of [['מעבר בין Chunks (cold)',r.panCold],['מעבר בין Chunks (warm)',r.panWarm]])if(p)L.push(`${lab}: ${p.fps} FPS · p95 ${p.frameMs.p95} · max ${p.frameMs.max} ms · >50ms ${p.over50} · >100ms ${p.over100}`);
 if(r.stress)L.push(`Stress לעתיד (+${r.stress.roadVehiclesAdded} רכבים, +${r.stress.pedestriansAdded} הולכי רגל, +${r.stress.extraFreightConsists} רכבות משא): ${r.stress.stress.fps} FPS (לפני ${r.stress.base.fps}) · p95 ${r.stress.stress.p95} · JS ${r.stress.stress.jsAvg} ms`);
 if(r.long)L.push(`ריצה ארוכה ${r.long.minutes} דק׳: ${r.long.fps} FPS · p95 ${r.long.frameMs.p95} · heap ${r.long.heapMB?r.long.heapMB.min+'–'+r.long.heapMB.max+'MB':'—'}`);
 if(r.memory)L.push(`זיכרון: JS ${r.memory.heapMB??'—'}MB · תמונות שמורות ${r.memory.canvasMB?r.memory.canvasMB.mb+'MB ('+r.memory.canvasMB.live+' canvases)':'—'} (סף 500MB)`);
 if(r.compare)L.push('מול '+r.compare.build+': '+Object.entries(r.compare.scenarios).map(([k,c])=>c.invalid?`${k} לא תקפה — לא הושווה`:`${k} p95 ${c.p95Before}→${c.p95Now} (${c.deltaPct>0?'+':''}${c.deltaPct}%${c.regression?' REGRESSION':''})`).join(' · '));
 return L.join('\n')}
function perfReportCopy(){const r=PERF.report||perfLastReport();if(!r){toast('אין עדיין דוח — הרץ Benchmark');return}const slim=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(r,(k,v)=>k==='compareBase'?undefined:v));copyText(perfReportText(r)+'\n\n'+JSON.stringify(slim),'דוח ה-Benchmark הועתק')}

function perfBenchHash(mode,seq){return'bench'+(mode==='webgl'?'&webgl':mode==='pq'?'&pq':'')+(seq?'&seq':'')+(/[#&]quick\b/.test(location.hash)?'&quick':'')}
function perfBenchStart(mode){mode=mode||'normal';
 if(PERF.busy)return;const all=mode==='all';
 if(!confirm(`Benchmark — ${PERF_MODE_HE[mode]}: המשחק נטען מחדש במצב בדיקה ומריץ לבד ${all?'שתי הרצות ברצף (רגיל, WebGL) — כ-14 דקות, ובסוף דוח אחד':'— כ-7 דקות'}.\n\nהמסך לא ייכבה והמחשב לא ייכנס לשינה בזמן הבדיקה (אם הדפדפן מאפשר — זה כתוב בדוח). סגירת המכסה עוצרת את הבדיקה; עדיף מחובר לחשמל.\n\nאל תעבור חלון ואל תגע בעכבר ובמקלדת עד הסוף. מדידה בלי פוקוס, או עם פחות מ-30 פריימים, מסומנת "לא תקפה" ונמדדת שוב פעם אחת.\n\nהמשחק נשמר לפני כן, והשמירה לא משתנה בזמן הבדיקה. להתחיל?`))return;
 try{SaveManager.save('manual',{silent:true})}catch{}if(all)try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_SEQ_KEY,JSON.stringify({t0:new Date().toISOString(),build:BUILD,runs:{}}))}catch{}
 try{localStorage.setItem('turbo_city_bench_req',String(Date.now()))}catch{}location.hash=perfBenchHash(all?'normal':mode,all);location.reload()}    
function perfSeqLoad(){try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_SEQ_KEY)||'null')}catch{return null}}
function perfSeqText(S){const L=[`Turbo City · Benchmark ברצף — רגיל / WebGL / pq · ${S.build} · ${S.t0}`],R=S.runs,modes=PERF_SEQ.filter(m=>R[m]);
 const scn=[...new Set(modes.flatMap(m=>Object.keys(R[m].scenarios||{})))];
 for(const k of scn)L.push(k+': '+modes.map(m=>{const v=R[m].scenarios[k];return v?`${PERF_MODE_HE[m]} ${v.invalid?'⚠ לא תקפה':v.fps+' FPS · p95 '+v.frameMs.p95+(v.ops?' · '+v.ops.avg+' פעולות':'')}`:PERF_MODE_HE[m]+' —'}).join(' | '));

function perfBenchTable(r){

 const BEAMR={'SH-MB-01':.34,'SH-SP-01':.34,'SH-RB-01':.4,'SH-YT-01':.27,'SH-PB-01':.3,'SH-FB-01':.33};
 function obb(x,y,h,L,B){const c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h),l=L/2,w=B/2;return[[x+l*c-w*s,y+l*s+w*c],[x-l*c-w*s,y-l*s+w*c],[x-l*c+w*s,y-l*s-w*c],[x+l*c+w*s,y+l*s-w*c]]}
 function sat(A,Bp){for(const P of[A,Bp])for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i],b=P[(i+1)%P.length],nx=b[1]-a[1],ny=a[0]-b[0];let a0=1e9,a1=-1e9,b0=1e9,b1=-1e9;for(const q of A){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<a0)a0=d;if(d>a1)a1=d}for(const q of Bp){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<b0)b0=d;if(d>b1)b1=d}if(a1<=b0||b1<=a0)return false}return true}
 const rectP=d=>[[d[0],d[1]],[d[2],d[1]],[d[2],d[3]],[d[0],d[3]]];
 const mooredF34=()=>F34_BOATS.filter(o=>!o.fish).map(o=>({id:o.id,P:obb(o.x,o.y,o.h,o.len*.96,o.len*(BEAMR[o.asset]||.33)*.92)}));
 function hullHit(b,x,y,h){const c=Math.cos(h),s=Math.sin(h),L=b.L,B=b.B,pts=[[L*.5,0],[L*.3,B*.45],[L*.3,-B*.45],[-L*.1,B*.5],[-L*.1,-B*.5],[-L*.5,B*.45],[-L*.5,-B*.45]];
  for(const [lx,ly] of pts){const px=x+lx*c-ly*s,py=y+lx*s+ly*c;if(!w3IsSea(px,py))return 'החוף';if(px>BTHZ[0]&&px<BTHZ[2]&&py>BTHZ[1]&&py<BTHZ[3])return 'קו המצופים של הרחצה'}
  if(x>6500&&x<8100&&y>1820&&y<2960){const H=obb(x,y,h,L*.97,B*.92),bx0=Math.min(...H.map(q=>q[0])),bx1=Math.max(...H.map(q=>q[0])),by0=Math.min(...H.map(q=>q[1])),by1=Math.max(...H.map(q=>q[1]));
   for(const d of F34_DECKS){if(d[0]>bx1||d[2]<bx0||d[1]>by1||d[3]<by0)continue;if(sat(H,rectP(d)))return 'המזח'}
   for(const o of F34_BOATS){if(o.fish)continue;if(Math.abs(o.x-x)>o.len+L||Math.abs(o.y-y)>o.len+L)continue;if(sat(H,obb(o.x,o.y,o.h,o.len*.96,o.len*(BEAMR[o.asset]||.33)*.92)))return 'סירה עוגנת'}
   for(const o of BOATS){if(o===b||o.id===b.id)continue;if(Math.abs(o.x-x)>o.L+L||Math.abs(o.y-y)>o.L+L)continue;if(sat(H,obb(o.x,o.y,o.h,o.L*.97,o.B*.92)))return 'סירה'}}
  if(HOOK.hit){try{const r=HOOK.hit(b,x,y,h);if(r)return r}catch(e){er('hit',e)}}    
  return null}
  
 function mtv(A,Bp){let best=1e9,bx=0,by=0;for(const Q of[A,Bp])for(let i=0;i<Q.length;i++){const a=Q[i],c=Q[(i+1)%Q.length];let nx=c[1]-a[1],ny=a[0]-c[0];const l=Math.hypot(nx,ny)||1;nx/=l;ny/=l;let a0=1e9,a1=-1e9,b0=1e9,b1=-1e9;
   for(const q of A){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<a0)a0=d;if(d>a1)a1=d}for(const q of Bp){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<b0)b0=d;if(d>b1)b1=d}const o=Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0);if(o<=0)return null;if(o<best){best=o;const sg=(a0+a1)<(b0+b1)?-1:1;bx=nx*sg*o;by=ny*sg*o}}return[bx,by]}
  
 function hullPush(b,x,y,h){const H=obb(x,y,h,b.L*.97,b.B*.92),R=b.L+40;let px=0,py=0,n=0;const add=Q=>{const m=mtv(H,Q);if(m){px+=m[0];py+=m[1];n++}};
  for(const d of F34_DECKS){if(d[0]>x+R||d[2]<x-R||d[1]>y+R||d[3]<y-R)continue;add(rectP(d))}
  for(const o of F34_BOATS){if(o.fish||Math.abs(o.x-x)>o.len+R||Math.abs(o.y-y)>o.len+R)continue;add(obb(o.x,o.y,o.h,o.len*.96,o.len*(BEAMR[o.asset]||.33)*.92))}
  for(const o of BOATS){if(o===b||o.id===b.id||Math.abs(o.x-x)>o.L+R||Math.abs(o.y-y)>o.L+R)continue;add(obb(o.x,o.y,o.h,o.L*.97,o.B*.92))}
  if(!n)return null;const l=Math.hypot(px,py)||1;return[px+px/l*.4,py+py/l*.4]}
  
 function bandX(H,y0,y1){let c0=1e9,c1=-1e9;const add=x=>{if(x<c0)c0=x;if(x>c1)c1=x};for(let i=0;i<H.length;i++){const a=H[i],q=H[(i+1)%H.length];if(a[1]>=y0&&a[1]<=y1)add(a[0]);
   for(const yy of[y0,y1])if((a[1]-yy)*(q[1]-yy)<0)add(a[0]+(q[0]-a[0])*(yy-a[1])/(q[1]-a[1]))}return c1>=c0?[c0,c1]:null}    
 function hullPushX(b,x,y,h,mx){const H=obb(x,y,h,b.L*.97,b.B*.92),R=b.L+40;let lo=0,hi=0;
  for(const d of F34_DECKS){if(d[0]>x+R||d[2]<x-R||d[1]>y+R||d[3]<y-R)continue;if(!sat(H,rectP(d)))continue;const c=bandX(H,d[1],d[3]);if(!c)continue;if(x<(d[0]+d[2])/2)lo=Math.min(lo,d[0]-c[1]);else hi=Math.max(hi,d[2]-c[0])}
  if(lo&&hi)return null;const sx=lo||hi;if(!sx||Math.abs(sx)>mx)return null;return sx+Math.sign(sx)*.4}
 function trail(b){const t=NOW();if(Math.abs(b.u)<5)return;const T=b.trail;if(T.length&&t-T[T.length-1].t<100)return;T.push({x:b.x-Math.cos(b.h)*b.L*.5,y:b.y-Math.sin(b.h)*b.L*.5,h:b.h,u:Math.abs(b.u),t});if(T.length>80)T.shift()}
 

 function anchorDrop(b,quiet){if(b.anchor&&b.anchor.st!=='up')return false;const W=seaNow(),R=cl(10+b.L*.1,12,28);let ax=b.x,ay=b.y;const sp=(S.f&&S.f.spot)||nearSpot(b.x,b.y);

  const up=W.dir+Math.PI,reach=b.L*.5+R+16;b.anchor={x:ax,y:ay,R,px:ax+Math.cos(up)*reach,py:ay+Math.sin(up)*reach,st:'down',t0:NOW()};
  if(!quiet)toast('העוגן במים — "'+b.name+'" מחזיקה מקום'+(sp?' מעל "'+sp.name+'"':''));try{SaveManager.log('fishing','anchor_down',{boat:b.id,spot:sp&&sp.id})}catch(e){}return true}
 function anchorUp(b,why){if(!b||!b.anchor||b.anchor.st==='up')return false;b.anchor.st='up';b.anchor.t0=NOW();if(why)toast(why);return true}
 function anchorHold(b,dt,nx,ny){const A=b.anchor;if(A.st==='up'&&NOW()-A.t0>1500){b.anchor=null;if(S.aboard===b.id)toast('העוגן למעלה — אפשר לשוט');return[nx,ny]}
  const vx=nx-A.x,vy=ny-A.y,dd=Math.hypot(vx,vy);if(dd>A.R){const k=Math.max(A.R,dd-8*dt)/dd;nx=A.x+vx*k;ny=A.y+vy*k}b.u*=Math.pow(.15,dt);b.vl*=Math.pow(.15,dt);
  const ht=Math.atan2(A.py-ny,A.px-nx);b.h=ang(b.h+cl(ang(ht-b.h),-.06*dt,.06*dt));return[nx,ny]}
 function anchorDraw(c,b,now){const A=b.anchor;if(!A)return;const L=b.L||60,B=b.B||22,fb=(b.fb||1)*KZ,c0=Math.cos(b.h),s0=Math.sin(b.h),bx=b.x+c0*L*.47,by=b.y+s0*L*.47;
  let dx=A.px-bx,dy=A.py-by;const dl=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;dx/=dl;dy/=dl;const k=Math.min(dl,4+L*.05),wx=bx+dx*k,wy=by+dy*k,t=NOW();
  let u=A.st==='up'?1-cl((t-A.t0)/1500,0,1):cl((t-A.t0)/1000,0,1);const px=lerp(wx,A.px,u),py=lerp(wy,A.py,u);c.save();

 const calmAt=(x,y)=>inBasin(x,y)||!!(HOOK.calm&&HOOK.calm(x,y));
 function physics(b,dt,thr,rud){const inB=calmAt(b.x,b.y),W=seaNow(),acc=b.acc,c1=acc*.4/b.maxV,c2=acc*.6/(b.maxV*b.maxV);
  b.u+=(thr*acc-c1*b.u-c2*b.u*Math.abs(b.u))*dt;if(inB&&b.u>BASIN_V)b.u=Math.max(BASIN_V,b.u-acc*1.6*dt);if(b.u<-b.maxV*.3)b.u=-b.maxV*.3;
  const sp=Math.abs(b.u),auth=cl(sp/(b.maxV*.3),0,1),pivot=sp<b.maxV*.12?.45:0,rt=rud*(b.turn*auth*(b.u<0?-1:1)+pivot);b.r+=(rt-b.r)*Math.min(1,dt*2.2);
  const t=NOW()/1000,h0=b.h;b.h=ang(b.h+b.r*dt+(inB?0:Math.sin(t*.8+b.ph)*.014*W.wave*dt));b.vl+=(-b.u*b.r*.32-b.vl*1.4)*dt;
  const dr=inB?0:(.32*W.wind+.6)*(1-cl(sp/60,0,.85)),dx=Math.cos(W.dir)*dr,dy=Math.sin(W.dir)*dr,fx=Math.cos(b.h),fy=Math.sin(b.h);
  let nx=b.x+(fx*b.u-fy*b.vl+dx)*dt,ny=b.y+(fy*b.u+fx*b.vl+dy)*dt;
  if(b.anchor){const q=anchorHold(b,dt,nx,ny);nx=q[0];ny=q[1]}    
  if(nx>9350||ny>7450||nx<-2600){b.u*=.9;nx=cl(nx,-2600,9350);ny=Math.min(ny,7450);if(!b.edgeT||NOW()-b.edgeT>4000){b.edgeT=NOW();toast('קצה הים של העיר — הסירה מאטה ונעצרת')}}    
  const hit=hullHit(b,nx,ny,b.h);if(hit){const imp=Math.abs(b.u),soft=hit!=='החוף'&&hit!=='קו המצופים של הרחצה',mx=nx-b.x,my=ny-b.y;let slid=null;
   

   if(soft&&Math.abs(my)>1.5*Math.abs(mx)){const sx=hullPushX(b,nx,ny,b.h,5);if(sx!=null&&!hullHit(b,nx+sx,ny,b.h))slid=[nx+sx,ny,Math.sign(sx),0,.98]}    
   if(soft&&!slid){const Pp=hullPush(b,nx,ny,b.h);if(Pp&&Pp[0]*mx+Pp[1]*my<=.25*Math.hypot(Pp[0],Pp[1])*Math.hypot(mx,my)&&!hullHit(b,nx+Pp[0],ny+Pp[1],b.h))slid=[nx+Pp[0],ny+Pp[1],Pp[0],Pp[1]];
    else if(Math.abs(mx)>.02&&!hullHit(b,nx,b.y,b.h))slid=[nx,b.y,0,-Math.sign(my)||1];else if(Math.abs(my)>.02&&!hullHit(b,b.x,ny,b.h))slid=[b.x,ny,-Math.sign(mx)||1,0]}
   if(slid){b.x=slid[0];b.y=slid[1];const pl=Math.hypot(slid[2],slid[3])||1,ux=slid[2]/pl,uy=slid[3]/pl,vx=fx*b.u-fy*b.vl,vy=fy*b.u+fx*b.vl,vn=vx*ux+vy*uy;
    if(vn<0){const wx=vx-1.3*vn*ux,wy=vy-1.3*vn*uy;b.u=(wx*fx+wy*fy)*(slid[4]||.85);b.vl=(-wx*fy+wy*fx)*.5}b.r*=.5}
   else{b.h=h0;b.u*=-.25;b.vl=0;b.r*=.3;const P0=soft?hullPush(b,b.x,b.y,b.h):null;if(P0&&!hullHit(b,b.x+P0[0],b.y+P0[1],b.h)){b.x+=P0[0];b.y+=P0[1]}}
   const fresh=NOW()-(b.bumpT||0)>700;b.bumpT=NOW();if(fresh){b.hitN=(b.hitN||0)+1;b.lastHit=hit;try{p599Shake&&p599Shake(2)}catch(e){}}if(fresh&&(imp>18||b.school)&&NOW()-b.hitT>1500){b.hitT=NOW();toast('הסירה נגעה ב'+hit+(b.school?' — במבחן זו פגיעה':' — לאט!'))}}else{b.x=nx;b.y=ny}
  trail(b)}
  
 function moveBy(b,dt){b.x+=Math.cos(b.h)*b.u*dt;b.y+=Math.sin(b.h)*b.u*dt;b.r=0;b.vl*=.9;trail(b)}
 function autopilot(b,dt){const L=b.legs[0];if(!L){arrive(b);return}
  if(L.k==='settle'){if(L.t==null){L.t=0;L.x0=b.x;L.y0=b.y;L.h0=b.h;L.dh=ang(L.h-b.h)}L.t+=dt;const u=cl(L.t/L.T,0,1),e=u*u*(3-2*u);b.x=lerp(L.x0,L.x,e);b.y=lerp(L.y0,L.y,e);b.h=ang(L.h0+L.dh*e);b.u=0;b.r=0;b.vl=0;if(u>=1){b.h=ang(L.h);b.legs.shift()}return}    
  if(L.k==='pivot'){const d=ang(L.h-b.h),w=cl(d*1.6,-.55,.55);b.h=ang(b.h+w*dt);b.u*=Math.pow(.15,dt);moveBy(b,dt);if(Math.abs(d)<.02&&Math.abs(b.u)<3)b.legs.shift();return}
  if(L.k==='hold'){L.t-=dt;b.u*=Math.pow(.3,dt);moveBy(b,dt);if(L.t<=0)b.legs.shift();return}
  const dx=L.x-b.x,dy=L.y-b.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),want=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+(L.rev?Math.PI:0),dh=ang(want-b.h);
  if(d<(L.tol||5)){b.legs.shift();if(L.end){b.x=L.x;b.y=L.y}return}
  if(L.end&&d<16){const k=Math.min(1,dt*2.5);b.x+=dx*k;b.y+=dy*k;b.u*=Math.pow(.2,dt);b.r=0;return}    
  const vmax=Math.min(L.v||b.maxV*.6,inBasin(b.x,b.y)?BASIN_V:1e9),vT=(L.rev?-1:1)*Math.min(vmax,Math.max(5,d*.8))*(Math.abs(dh)>.8?.3:1);
  b.h=ang(b.h+cl(dh*2.2,-1,1)*(Math.abs(b.u)>4?b.turn*.9:.5)*dt);b.u+=cl(vT-b.u,-b.acc*1.4*dt,b.acc*dt);moveBy(b,dt)}
 function arrive(b){if(b.onArrive){const f=b.onArrive;b.onArrive=null;return f(b)}if(b.mode==='return'||b.mode==='moor'){const wasMoor=b.mode==='moor';b.mode='moored';b.u=0;b.h=b.moorH!=null?b.moorH:b.be.h;b.moorH=null;save(b);if(wasMoor&&S.aboard===b.id)stepAshore(b,'berth')}else if(b.mode==='auto'){if(b.school&&S.exam&&S.exam.demo){b.mode='moor';b.legs=legsHome(b);return}b.mode='player';S.demo=null}}
 const go=(x,y,v,o)=>Object.assign({k:'go',x,y,v},o||{}),pivot=h=>({k:'pivot',h});
 const laneY=b=>b.be.lane!=null?b.be.lane:(b.be.lane=laneOf(b));
 function legsOut(b,to){if(b.route)return b.route.out(b,to);const be=b.be,ly=laneY(b),fw=Math.abs(ang(Math.atan2(ly-be.cy,0)-(b.h!=null?b.h:be.h)))<Math.PI/2,L=[go(be.cx,ly,9,{rev:!fw,tol:3}),pivot(0),go(FAIR_X,ly,24),pivot(Math.PI/2),go(FAIR_S[0],FAIR_S[1],24),go(GAP_IN[0],GAP_IN[1],24),go(GAP_OUT[0],GAP_OUT[1],40,{tol:10})];if(to)L.push(go(to[0],to[1],b.maxV*.65,{tol:16}));return L}
 function seaLine(x0,y0,x1,y1){for(let i=1;i<=14;i++){const x=lerp(x0,x1,i/14),y=lerp(y0,y1,i/14);if(!w3IsSea(x,y)||(x>BTHZ[0]-20&&x<BTHZ[2]+20&&y>BTHZ[1]-20&&y<BTHZ[3]+20)||(HOOK.keep&&HOOK.keep(x,y)))return false}return true}
 function legsHome(b){if(b.route)return b.route.home(b);const be=b.be,L=[];
  if(inBasin(b.x,b.y)){const ly=b.y<2010?LANES[0]:b.y<2350?LANES[1]:LANES[2],rev=Math.abs(ang(Math.atan2(ly-b.y,0)-b.h))>Math.PI/2;if(Math.abs(b.y-ly)>6)L.push(go(b.x,ly,9,{rev,tol:4}));
   if(ly!==laneY(b)){L.push(go(FAIR_X,ly,20),go(FAIR_X,laneY(b),20))}}
  else{if(!seaLine(b.x,b.y,GAP_OUT[0],GAP_OUT[1])){if(b.x>7160&&b.y<2960)L.push(go(b.x,2960,b.maxV*.6,{tol:20}));else L.push(go(Math.max(b.x,7120),b.y,b.maxV*.6,{tol:20}));L.push(go(7120,2880,b.maxV*.6,{tol:20}))    }
   L.push(go(GAP_OUT[0],GAP_OUT[1],b.maxV*.55,{tol:12}),go(GAP_IN[0],GAP_IN[1],22),go(FAIR_S[0],FAIR_S[1],20),pivot(-Math.PI/2),go(FAIR_X,laneY(b),20))}
  L.push(pivot(Math.PI),go(be.cx,laneY(b),14,{tol:3}),pivot(be.h),go(be.cx,be.cy,7,{tol:2,end:true}),pivot(be.h));return L}
  
 function inBerth(b){const r=b.be.rect;return b.x>r[0]-6&&b.x<r[2]+6&&b.y>r[1]-10&&b.y<r[3]+10}
 function dockH(b){const a=b.be.h,o=ang(a+Math.PI);return Math.abs(ang(a-b.h))<=Math.abs(ang(o-b.h))?a:o}
 function legsDock(b){const h=dockH(b);b.moorH=h;return[{k:'settle',x:b.be.cx,y:b.be.cy,h,T:cl(.6+Math.hypot(b.x-b.be.cx,b.y-b.be.cy)/25+Math.abs(ang(h-b.h))*.9,.6,2.6)}]}
 function legsMoor(b){return inBerth(b)?legsDock(b):legsHome(b)}
  
 function helmLocal(b){return b.helm||(b.kind==='console'?[-b.L*.1,0]:[-b.L*.22,0])}
 function aftLocal(b,side){return[-b.L*.33,side*b.B*.16]}
 function placePed(b){const [lx,ly]=(S.f&&S.f.phase!=='idle')?aftLocal(b,S.f.side||1):helmLocal(b),c=Math.cos(b.h),s=Math.sin(b.h);PlayerPed.x=b.x+lx*c-ly*s;PlayerPed.y=b.y+lx*s+ly*c;PlayerPed.heading=b.h;PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;
  try{PlayerPed.dir=personDirection(c,s)}catch(e){}S.pedX=PlayerPed.x;S.pedY=PlayerPed.y}
 function take(b){const p=P();clearFishState();b.anchor=null;S.aboard=b.id;p.aboard=b.id;b.mode='player';b.u=0;b.r=0;b.legs=[];placePed(b);try{State.navigation=null}catch(e){}return true}    
 function board(b){const p=P();if(b.owned)return HOOK.board?HOOK.board(b):false;if(b.school){if(!S.exam||S.exam.phase!=='board')return toast('סירת המבחן של בית הספר לשייט — עולים עליה רק במבחן לרישיון סירה (במועדון השייט)');if(b.mode!=='moored')return toast('הסירה עוד לא במעגן');
   clearFishState();S.aboard=b.id;p.aboard=b.id;b.mode='player';b.u=0;b.r=0;placePed(b);S.exam.phase='run';S.exam.t0=NOW();S.exam.hit0=b.hitT||0;S.exam.hitN0=b.hitN||0;S.exam.px=b.x;S.exam.py=b.y;toast('המבחן התחיל! יציאה מהמעגן, 4 שערים בין המצופים — דרומה, וחזרה למעגן '+b.be.n+'. באגן עד 5 קשר, בלי פגיעה, עד 4 דקות');return true}
  if(!p.rental||p.rental.boat!==b.id)return toast('הסירה "'+b.name+'" להשכרה — שוכרים במועדון השייט (F במועדון)');if(b.mode!=='moored')return toast('הסירה עוד לא במעגן');
  clearFishState();S.aboard=b.id;p.aboard=b.id;p.rental.boarded=1;b.mode='player';b.u=0;b.r=0;placePed(b);try{State.navigation=null}catch(e){}
  toast('עלית לסירה "'+b.name+'" · W ו-S מצערת · A ו-D הגה · רווח — עצירה · באגן עד 5 קשר · היציאה לים דרך הפתח שליד הפנס הירוק');SaveManager.log('fishing','boat_board',{boat:b.id});return true}
 function nearDeck(x,y,r){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const d of[...S9DF.piers.map(q=>q.rect),S9DF.fuel_pontoon.rect,[6560,1819,7200,1880],...(HOOK.decks?HOOK.decks():[])]){const px=cl(x,d[0],d[2]),py=cl(y,d[1],d[3]),dd=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=[px,py]}}return bd<=r?best:null}
 function tryLeave(){const b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b)return false;if(S.f&&S.f.phase!=='idle')return toast('קודם מרימים את החכה (F)');const be=b.be,d=Math.hypot(b.x-be.cx,b.y-be.cy);
  if(Math.abs(b.u)>14)return toast('מאטים לפני הקשירה');
  if(inBerth(b)){b.mode='moor';b.legs=legsDock(b);S.mooring=true;toast('קושרים את "'+b.name+'" במעגן '+be.n+'…');return true}
  if(b.owned&&HOOK.dock){const r=HOOK.dock(b);if(r)return true}
  if(d<90)return toast('התקרב למעגן '+be.n+' — היכנס לתוך המקום, ואז E');
  if(b.school&&S.exam&&S.exam.phase==='run')return toast('במבחן — חוזרים למעגן '+be.n+' וקושרים (E ליד המעגן)');
  const dk=nearDeck(b.x,b.y,30);if(dk){clearFishState();S.aboard=null;P().aboard=null;PlayerPed.x=dk[0];PlayerPed.y=dk[1];PlayerPed.pose='idle';b.mode='return';b.legs=legsHome(b);if(b.owned){if(HOOK.left)HOOK.left(b,'deck')}else closeRental('deck');return true}
  return toast(inBasin(b.x,b.y)?'אי אפשר לרדת כאן — מתקרבים למזח או למעגן '+be.n:'אי אפשר לרדת מהסירה בים — חוזרים למרינה')}
  
 function clearFishState(){try{S.f=null;const s=State.fishingSession;if(s){if(s.busy)s.busy=false;s.last=null;s.lastAt=0;s.hooked=null}State.fishingSetup=null}catch(e){}}
 function stepAshore(b,why){clearFishState();b.anchor=null;S.aboard=null;S.mooring=false;P().aboard=null;const [bx,by]=b.be.board;PlayerPed.x=bx;PlayerPed.y=by;PlayerPed.pose='idle';PlayerPed.moving=false;if(b.school){examFinish(b);return}if(b.owned){if(HOOK.ashore)HOOK.ashore(b,why);return}closeRental(why)}
 function leaveBoat(b,why){clearFishState();b.anchor=null;S.aboard=null;S.mooring=false;S.f=null;P().aboard=null;b.mode='return';b.legs=legsHome(b);if(b.owned){if(HOOK.left)HOOK.left(b,why);return}if(b.school){examFail('ירדת מהסירה באמצע המבחן');examFinish(b);return}if(P().rental)closeRental(why)}
  
 function rentLeft(){const r=P().rental;if(!r)return 0;return r.from+r.hours*60-clockNow().abs}
 function rent(id,hours){init();const b=boatById(id),p=P();if(!b)return;if(b.school)return toast('סירת המבחן לא להשכרה — היא של בית הספר לשייט');if(!licenseOwned('LIC-12'))return toast('לדיג העמוק צריך רישיון דיג עמוק — '+(typeof LIC570!=='undefined'?LIC570.missingText():'15 תפיסות באגם ו-10 בחוף'));if(S.exam)return toast('קודם מסיימים את מבחן הסירה');if(p.rental)return toast('כבר יש לך סירה שכורה — "'+boatById(p.rental.boat).name+'"');if(b.mode!=='moored')return toast('"'+b.name+'" עוד לא חזרה למעגן');
  const price=b.price*hours+PERMIT;if(PlayerProfile.money<price)return toast('אין מספיק כסף — צריך '+money(price));PlayerProfile.money-=price;
  try{recordTransaction('boat-rental',-price,{boat:id,hours})}catch(e){}p.rental={boat:id,from:clockNow().abs,hours,paid:price,baits:{...b.baits},at:isoNow()};
  try{g77MsgIn('pl-club','"'+b.name+'" מחכה לך במעגן '+b.be.n+' ('+(b.be.pier==='PIER-1'?'המזח הראשון':'המזח השני')+'). עולים ב-F או ב-E ליד הסירה. באגן — לאט, עד 5 קשר.')}catch(e){}
  try{setNavigationTarget('F3-BOARD-'+b.id,{silent:true})}catch(e){}SaveManager.log('fishing','boat_rent',{boat:id,hours,price});try{SaveManager.save('boat-rent',{backup:false,silent:true})}catch(e){}
  toast('שכרת את "'+b.name+'" ל-'+hours+' '+(hours===1?'שעה':'שעות')+' · '+money(price));return true}
 function cancelRental(){const p=P(),r=p.rental;if(!r)return;if(r.boarded)return toast('הסירה כבר יצאה — מחזירים אותה למעגן');const back=boatById(r.boat).price*r.hours;PlayerProfile.money+=back;try{recordTransaction('boat-rental-refund',back,{boat:r.boat})}catch(e){}p.rental=null;toast('ההשכרה בוטלה · הוחזרו '+money(back))}
 function closeRental(why){const p=P(),r=p.rental;if(!r)return;const b=boatById(r.boat),used=clockNow().abs-r.from,over=Math.max(0,used-r.hours*60),extra=Math.ceil(over/60-1e-6)*b.price,fee=why==='berth'?0:60,tot=extra+fee;
  if(tot){PlayerProfile.money-=tot;try{recordTransaction('boat-rental-extra',-tot,{boat:b.id,over:Math.round(over),fee})}catch(e){}}p.rental=null;p.trips=(p.trips||0)+1;
  const txt=why==='berth'?'"'+b.name+'" קשורה במעגן '+b.be.n+' — תודה!':'"'+b.name+'" חוזרת למעגן עם אורי מהמועדון'+(fee?' · שירות החזרה '+g77Coins(fee):'');    
  try{g77MsgIn('pl-club',txt+(extra?' · שעות נוספות '+g77Coins(extra):''))}catch(e){try{toast(g77CoinsHtml(txt))}catch(e2){}}SaveManager.log('fishing','boat_return',{boat:b.id,why,over:Math.round(over),extra,fee});try{SaveManager.save('boat-return',{backup:false,silent:true})}catch(e){}}
 function rentalTick(){const p=P(),r=p.rental;if(!r)return;const left=rentLeft();if(left<0&&!r.warned){r.warned=1;try{g77MsgIn('pl-club','הזמן של "'+boatById(r.boat).name+'" נגמר — חוזרים למעגן. כל שעה נוספת במחיר של שעה.')}catch(e){}}
  if(left<-12*60&&!r.boarded){p.rental=null;try{g77MsgIn('pl-club','לא הגעת לסירה — ההשכרה נסגרה.')}catch(e){}}}
  
 

 const EXAM={fee:120,limit:240,gates:[3450,3650,3850,4050].map((y,i)=>({n:i+1,y,x0:6600,x1:6950})),box:[6540,2440,7220,4200]};
 const examClock=()=>{const e=S.exam;if(!e||!e.t0)return '4:00';const l=Math.max(0,EXAM.limit-(NOW()-e.t0)/1000);return Math.floor(l/60)+':'+String(Math.floor(l%60)).padStart(2,'0')};
 function examRec(){const p=P();return p.exam||(p.exam={tries:0,passes:0,best:null,last:null,log:[]})}
 function examStart(){init();const sb=BOATS.find(b=>b.school);if(licenseOwned('LIC-10'))return toast('רישיון הסירה כבר בבעלותך');if(S.exam)return toast('המבחן כבר פתוח — סירת המבחן במעגן '+sb.be.n);if(S.aboard||P().rental)return toast('קודם מחזירים את הסירה השכורה');
  if(sb.mode!=='moored')return toast('סירת המבחן עוד חוזרת למעגן');if(PlayerProfile.money<EXAM.fee)return toast('אגרת המבחן — '+money(EXAM.fee));PlayerProfile.money-=EXAM.fee;try{recordTransaction('license-exam',-EXAM.fee,{id:'LIC-10'})}catch(e){}
  S.exam={phase:'board',next:0,hits:0,slowT:0,outT:0,why:null};examRec().tries++;examCard('info');try{setNavigationTarget('F3-BOARD-'+sb.id,{silent:true})}catch(e){}
  try{g77MsgIn('pl-school','המבחן לרישיון סירה: סירת המבחן במעגן '+sb.be.n+'. עולים ב-F או ב-E. יוצאים מהמעגן, עוברים 4 שערים בין המצופים — דרומה, וחוזרים לקשור. באגן — עד 5 קשר. בהצלחה!')}catch(e){}SaveManager.log('license','boat_exam_start',{});return true}
 function examFail(why){const e=S.exam;if(!e||e.phase==='failed')return;e.phase='failed';e.why=why;const b=BOATS.find(q=>q.school);toast('המבחן נכשל — '+why+' · המדריך מחזיר את הסירה למעגן; אפשר לנסות שוב');
  if(b&&S.aboard===b.id){b.mode='moor';b.legs=legsHome(b)}}
 function examStep(b,dt){const e=S.exam;if(!e||e.phase!=='run')return;const t=(NOW()-e.t0)/1000;
  if(t>EXAM.limit)return examFail('הזמן נגמר (4 דקות)');if((b.hitN||0)>e.hitN0){e.hits=(b.hitN||0)-e.hitN0;e.hitV=1;return examFail('פגיעה ב'+(b.lastHit||'מזח')+' — במבחן אסור לגעת')}
  if(inBasin(b.x,b.y)&&Math.abs(b.u)>BASIN_V*1.12){e.slowT+=dt;if(e.slowT>1.5){e.speedV=1;return examFail('מהירות באגן מעל 5 קשר')}}else e.slowT=Math.max(0,e.slowT-dt);
  const X=EXAM.box,inside=inBasin(b.x,b.y)||(b.x>X[0]&&b.x<X[2]&&b.y>X[1]&&b.y<X[3]);if(!inside){e.outT+=dt;if(e.outT>3){e.outV=1;return examFail('יצאת מנתיב המבחן')}}else e.outT=0;
  const g=EXAM.gates[e.next];if(g&&e.py<g.y&&b.y>=g.y){const f=(g.y-e.py)/Math.max(1e-6,b.y-e.py),x=e.px+(b.x-e.px)*f;if(x>g.x0&&x<g.x1){e.next++;toast(e.next<EXAM.gates.length?'שער '+e.next+' / '+EXAM.gates.length:'כל השערים! חוזרים למעגן '+b.be.n+' וקושרים')}else return examFail('עברת מחוץ לשער '+g.n)}
  e.px=b.x;e.py=b.y}
 function examFinish(b){clearFishState();const e=S.exam;if(!e)return;S.exam=null;const R=examRec(),sec=e.t0?Math.round((NOW()-e.t0)/1000):0;let ok=e.phase==='run'&&e.next>=EXAM.gates.length&&sec<=EXAM.limit;

 function examRun(skip){init();const sb=BOATS.find(b=>b.school);if(S.aboard||P().rental||sb.mode!=='moored')return{err:'busy'};const had=licenseOwned('LIC-10');if(had)delete PlayerProfile.licenses['LIC-10'];PlayerProfile.money=Math.max(PlayerProfile.money,500);

 function examRoute(){const sb=BOATS.find(q=>q.school),be=sb.be,ly=laneY(sb),G=EXAM.gates,mid=g=>[(g.x0+g.x1)/2,g.y];

 const TUNE={w0:2.2,w1:4.4,react:.8,over:2.0,reel:1.25};    
 function simFight(q,row,cfg,W,b){const rod=RODS3[cfg.rod],pow=row.weightKg*q.pow*.32,dt=1/30;let line=(row.depthM||20)+6+Math.random()*6,T=.35,stam=1,runT=0,run=0,tt=0;
  for(;tt<240;tt+=dt){if(tt>runT){const big=Math.random()<.45;run=big?(.45+Math.random()*.55)*stam:.12*stam;runT=tt+(big?.9+Math.random()*1.9:.7+Math.random()*1.3)}
   const ratio=cl(pow*run/rod.line,0,2.2),noise=W.wave*.07*Math.sin(tt*1000/140)+(W.storm?.08*Math.sin(tt*1000/57):0),hold=T<.7;let Tt;
   if(hold){line=Math.max(0,line-rod.spd*TUNE.reel*(1-Math.min(.88,ratio*.75))*dt);Tt=.24+ratio*.62+noise}else{if(run>.3)line+=ratio*4.2*dt;Tt=.1+ratio*.36+noise*.5}
   T+=(Tt-T)*Math.min(1,dt*4.5);stam=Math.max(.18,stam-dt*(hold?.045:.02)*(run>.3?1.6:1));
   if(q.id==='FS-SE-05'&&tt<4.5&&!hold&&Math.random()<.035*dt)return{t:tt,ok:false};if(T>=1||line>rod.cap||Math.random()<(.004+W.wave*.004)*dt*(hold?1:.5))return{t:tt,ok:false};
   if(line<=1.6){const tool=TOOLS3[cfg.tool],ok=b.tools.includes(cfg.tool)&&row.weightKg<=tool.max;if(!ok&&Math.random()<.55)return{t:tt,ok:false};return{t:tt+.9+2.8,ok:true}}}return{t:tt,ok:false}}
 function rateSim(hours,o){o=o||{};const tune=Object.assign({},TUNE),old=o.old;if(old)Object.assign(TUNE,{w0:3.5,w1:7,reel:1});const secH=60/(G84_CLOCK.rate||.5),out=[];
  try{for(const b of BOATS.filter(q=>!q.school))for(const s of SPOTS)for(const h of[6,12,22]){const W=seaAt(1+(h%3),h),bottom=s.bottom,cfg=defaultCfg(b,s,bottom);let t=0,n=0,big=0,val=0,lost=0;const bb=Object.assign({},b,{u:0});
     while(t<hours*secH){const rows=weights(cfg,s,bottom,W,h,bb),sum=rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.w,0);t+=TUNE.over+1.1+effDepth(cfg,bottom,W)/((WEIGHTS3[cfg.weight].sink||3)*1.6);if(sum<.05){t+=9;continue}
      t+=(TUNE.w0+Math.random()*TUNE.w1)/cl(sum/14,.35,1.7)+TUNE.react;let r=Math.random()*sum,q=rows[0].q;for(const x of rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){q=x.q;break}}
      const row=makeRow(q,pickSize(RODS3[cfg.rod].cls,BAITS3[cfg.bait].key),{spot:s,cfg,depth:effDepth(cfg,bottom,W)}),F=simFight(q,row,cfg,W,b);t+=F.t;if(F.ok){if(t>hours*secH)break;n++;val+=row.value;if(row.sizeIndex>=2)big++}else{lost++;t+=1.5}}
     out.push({boat:b.name,spot:s.name,hour:h,perHour:+(n/hours).toFixed(2),bigPerHour:+(big/hours).toFixed(2),valuePerHour:Math.round(val/hours),avgValue:n?Math.round(val/n):0,lostPerHour:+(lost/hours).toFixed(2)})}}finally{Object.assign(TUNE,tune)}
  const by=k=>{const g={};for(const r of out){(g[r[k]]=g[r[k]]||[]).push(r)}return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(g).map(([n,L])=>[n,{perHour:+(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.perHour,0)/L.length).toFixed(2),bigPerHour:+(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.bigPerHour,0)/L.length).toFixed(2),valuePerHour:Math.round(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.valuePerHour,0)/L.length),avgValue:Math.round(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.avgValue,0)/L.length)}]))};
  const common=['FS-SE-02','FS-SE-04','FS-SE-05','FS-SE-07','FS-SE-12'].map(id=>SEA_ID[id].value),two=Math.round(2*common.reduce((a,v)=>a+v,0)/common.length);
  return{hours,secPerGameHour:secH,byBoat:by('boat'),bySpot:by('spot'),rows:out,twoCommonFish:two,prices:BOATS.filter(q=>!q.school).map(b=>({boat:b.name,before:b.price0,after:b.price}))}}
  
 function stepAll(dt){try{init();if(S.aboard){const b=boatById(S.aboard);if(PlayerProfile.mode!=='walk'||State.taxiRide||State.ferryRide||Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-S.pedX,PlayerPed.y-S.pedY)>40){leaveBoat(b,'away');if(!b.owned)try{g77MsgIn('pl-club','השארת את "'+b.name+'" — אני מחזיר אותה למעגן.')}catch(e){}}}

 function stepAboard(dt){const b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b)return;if(b.mode==='player'){const fishing=S.f&&S.f.phase!=='idle',lock=S.menu||fishing,fw=Input.down('KeyW','ArrowUp'),bw=Input.down('KeyS','ArrowDown'),br=Input.down('Space'),lr=(Input.down('KeyD','ArrowRight')?1:0)-(Input.down('KeyA','ArrowLeft')?1:0);

 function inv(id){const r=P().rental;return((r&&r.baits&&r.baits[id])||0)+(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]||0)}
 function useBait(id){const q=BAITS3[id];if(!q||q.reuse)return;const r=P().rental;if(r&&r.baits&&r.baits[id]>0){r.baits[id]--;return}if(PlayerProfile.inventory[id]>0)PlayerProfile.inventory[id]--}
 function gearOf(b){const r=P().rental;return{rods:b.rods,tools:b.tools,weights:b.weights,baits:Object.keys(BAITS3).filter(id=>inv(id)>0||(b.baits[id]!=null))}}
 function defaultCfg(b,spot,bottom){const g=gearOf(b),rod=g.rods[g.rods.length-1],bait=g.baits.find(id=>inv(id)>0)||'sea-squid',w=g.weights.includes('w300')?'w300':g.weights[0];return{rod,bait,weight:w,depth:Math.min(bottom,Math.max(10,Math.round(bottom*.85))),bottomMode:true,tool:g.tools.includes('gaff')?'gaff':'net'}}
 function effDepth(cfg,bottom,W){const w=WEIGHTS3[cfg.weight],drift=1-cl((W.wind-8)*.025+(W.wave-.6)*.12,0,.5),mx=cfg.weight==='w0'?w.max:Math.round(w.max*drift),reel=RODS3[cfg.rod].cap*.9;return Math.max(1,Math.min(cfg.bottomMode?bottom:cfg.depth,bottom,mx,reel))}
 function weights(cfg,spot,bottom,W,h,b){const hab=spot?spot.hab:'none',T=tod(h),rod=RODS3[cfg.rod],D=effDepth(cfg,bottom,W),bk=BAITS3[cfg.bait].key,moving=b&&Math.abs(b.u)>14&&Math.abs(b.u)<50,rows=[];
  for(const q of SEA){let w=(hab==='none'?.6:q.hab[hab]||0)*(q.b[bk]||0);if(!w){rows.push({q,w:0,why:'לא בפיתיון הזה או במקום הזה'});continue}
   const dr=(q.dn&&T==='night')?q.dn:q.d;let why='';
   if(q.bot){if(!(bottom>=dr[0]&&bottom<=dr[1])){w*=.05;why='התחתית לא בעומק שלו'}else if(D<bottom-8){w*=.08;why='צריך להגיע לתחתית'}}else if(D<dr[0]||D>dr[1]){w*=.07;why='לא בעומק שלו ('+dr[0]+'–'+dr[1]+' מ׳)'}
   const need=(q.rodN&&T==='night')?q.rodN:q.rod;if(rod.cls<need){w*=.3;why=why||'צריך חכה כבדה יותר'}
   if(q.tod==='dawn'&&T==='dawn')w*=1.7;else if(q.tod==='night'){w*=T==='night'?1.9:.55}else if(q.tod==='day'&&T==='day')w*=1.3;else if(T==='night'&&q.tod!=='night')w*=.6;
   if(W.wave<.5&&!q.bot)w*=.8;else if(W.wave<1.6)w*=1.2;else w*=.6;
   if(cfg.weight==='w0'){if(bk==='plug'&&moving&&!q.bot)w*=2.2;else w*=.25}
   rows.push({q,w,why})}
  return rows}
 function odds(cfg,spot,bottom,W,h,b){const rows=weights(cfg,spot,bottom,W,h,b),sum=rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.w,0)||1;return rows.map(r=>({...r,pct:100*r.w/sum})).sort((a,b)=>b.pct-a.pct)}
 const SIZE_ODDS={1:[40,38,18,4],2:[30,38,25,7],3:[24,36,30,10]};
 function pickSize(cls,bk){const o=SIZE_ODDS[cls].slice();if(bk==='live'||bk==='chunk'){o[0]-=8;o[2]+=5;o[3]+=3}let r=Math.random()*100;for(let i=0;i<4;i++){r-=o[i];if(r<=0)return i}return 1}
 function makeRow(q,si,f){const len=Math.max(12,Math.round(q.base*FISH_SIZE_SCALE[si]*(.88+Math.random()*.22))),kg=q.k*Math.pow(len/100,3),value=Math.max(8,Math.round(q.value*FISH_VALUE_MULT[si]*len/q.base));
  return{catchId:'FISH-'+Date.now().toString(36)+'-'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),id:q.id,name:q.name,size:FISH_SIZE_NAMES[si],sizeIndex:si,lengthCm:len,weightKg:+kg.toFixed(kg<10?1:0),value,
   spot:f.spot?f.spot.id:'F3-SEA',habitat:'sea',bait:f.cfg.bait,rod:f.cfg.rod,depthM:Math.round(f.depth),boat:S.aboard,caughtAt:isoNow()}}

 function startDrop(){const b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b)return toast('צריך להיות על הסירה');if(inBasin(b.x,b.y))return toast('באגן המרינה לא דגים — יוצאים לים דרך הפתח');const cfg=S.cfg;if(!cfg)return;

 function biteWait(f){const b=boatById(S.aboard),rows=weights(f.cfg,f.spot,f.bottom,f.W,clockNow().h,b),sum=rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.w,0);return{rows,sum,ms:(TUNE.w0+Math.random()*TUNE.w1)*1000/cl(sum/14,.35,1.7)*(b&&b.biteK||1)}}
 function fishStep(dt){const f=S.f;if(!f||f.phase==='idle')return;const t=NOW(),b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b){S.f=null;return}
  if(f.phase==='drop'){const k=WEIGHTS3[f.cfg.weight].sink||3;if(t-f.t0>1100){f.depth=Math.min(f.target,f.depth+k*dt*1.6);if(f.depth>=f.target-.01){f.phase='wait';const w=biteWait(f);f.biteAt=t+w.ms;f.sum=w.sum}}return}
  if(f.phase==='wait'){if(f.cfg.weight==='w0')f.depth=cl(2+Math.abs(b.u)*.04,1,4);if(t>=f.biteAt){const w=biteWait(f);if(w.sum<.05){f.biteAt=t+9000;if(!f.toldNone){f.toldNone=1;toast('אין נשיכות — נסו עומק, פיתיון או נקודה אחרת')}return}
    let r=Math.random()*w.sum,q=w.rows[0].q;for(const x of w.rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){q=x.q;break}}const si=pickSize(RODS3[f.cfg.rod].cls,BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].key);f.row=makeRow(q,si,f);f.q=q;f.phase='bite';f.biteT=t;
    toast('נשיכה! F — להכות');try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_bite',{id:q.id,size:f.row.size,spot:f.spot&&f.spot.id,depth:Math.round(f.depth)})}catch(e){}}return}
  if(f.phase==='bite'){if(S.auto&&t-f.biteT>500)strike();else if(t-f.biteT>3200){f.phase='wait';f.biteAt=t+biteWait(f).ms;if(!BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].reuse&&Math.random()<.5){useBait(f.cfg.bait);toast('הדג לקח את הפיתיון — שמים פיתיון חדש')}else toast('הדג עזב — ממתינים שוב')}return}
  if(f.phase==='fight'){const rod=RODS3[f.cfg.rod],pow=f.row.weightKg*f.q.pow*.32,W=f.W;if(t>f.runT){const big=Math.random()<.45;f.run=big?(.45+Math.random()*.55)*f.stam:.12*f.stam;f.runT=t+(big?900+Math.random()*1900:700+Math.random()*1300)}
   const ratio=cl(pow*f.run/rod.line,0,2.2),noise=W.wave*.07*Math.sin(t/140)+(W.storm?.08*Math.sin(t/57):0),hold=S.auto?(f.T<.7):(S.hold||Input.down('KeyF'));
   let tt;if(hold){f.line=Math.max(0,f.line-rod.spd*TUNE.reel*(1-Math.min(.88,ratio*.75))*dt);tt=.24+ratio*.62+noise}else{if(f.run>.3)f.line+=ratio*4.2*dt;tt=.1+ratio*.36+noise*.5}
   f.T+=(tt-f.T)*Math.min(1,dt*4.5);f.stam=Math.max(.18,f.stam-dt*(hold?.045:.02)*(f.run>.3?1.6:1));
   if(f.q.id==='FS-SE-05'&&t-f.hookT<4500&&!hold&&Math.random()<.035*dt*30/30)return lose('הלוקוס נכנס לסלעים של השונית וקרע את החוט');
   if(f.T>=1)return lose('החוט נקרע — המתיחה גבוהה מדי');if(f.line>rod.cap)return lose('הסליל התרוקן — הדג לקח את כל החוט');if(Math.random()<(.004+W.wave*.004)*dt*(hold?1:.5))return lose('הקרס השתחרר');
   if(f.line<=1.6){const tool=TOOLS3[f.cfg.tool],ok=b.tools.includes(f.cfg.tool)&&f.row.weightKg<=tool.max;if(!ok&&Math.random()<.55)return lose(f.row.weightKg>15?'בלי גאף הדג הגדול נפל ליד הסירה':'הדג נפל ליד הסירה');f.phase='land';f.landT=t}return}
  if(f.phase==='land'){if(t-f.landT>900){f.phase='hold';f.holdT=t;finishCatch(f)}return}
  if(f.phase==='hold'){if(t-f.holdT>2800){S.f={phase:'idle',last:f.row,cfg:f.cfg};S.auto=false}return}
  if(f.phase==='lost'){if(t-f.lostT>1500)S.f={phase:'idle',cfg:f.cfg}}}
 function strike(){const f=S.f;if(!f||f.phase!=='bite')return;f.phase='fight';f.hookT=NOW();f.line=f.depth+6+Math.random()*6;f.T=.35;f.runT=0;f.stam=1;toast('הדג על הקרס! החזק F כדי לגלגל, ושחרר כשהמתיחה באדום')}
 function lose(msg){const f=S.f;f.phase='lost';S.auto=false;f.lostT=NOW();const fx=ensureFishingSchema();fx.totalEscaped=(fx.totalEscaped||0)+1;toast(msg);try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_lost',{id:f.row&&f.row.id,why:msg})}catch(e){}}

  try{fishx7Card(row,rec);const c=document.querySelector('#fishCatchCard .cf');if(c)c.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<span>'+kgTxt(row.weightKg)+'</span>')}catch(e){}

 function paintFish(root){const L=[...root.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-f3fish]')];if(!L.length)return;const mx=Math.max(...L.map(c=>+c.dataset.cm||50)),dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
  L.forEach(cv=>{const W=Math.max(80,Math.round(cv.getBoundingClientRect().width||cv.clientWidth||170)),H=64,id=cv.dataset.f3fish,cm=+cv.dataset.cm||50;cv.width=Math.round(W*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(H*dpr);const g=cv.getContext('2d');g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
   const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);gr.addColorStop(0,'#1f7096');gr.addColorStop(1,'#11455f');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.07)';g.lineWidth=1;for(let y=9;y<H;y+=11){g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=8)g.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x*.06+y)*1.1);g.stroke()}
   try{const I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:1,sz:2,variant:0}),fp=(I.fp&&I.fp[2]>0)?I.fp:[0,0,I.w,I.h],fr=.3+.6*Math.sqrt(cm/mx),sc=Math.min(W*fr/fp[2],(H-16)/fp[3]),J=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,sz:2,variant:0}),f2=(J.fp&&J.fp[2]>0)?J.fp:[0,0,J.w,J.h],x=W/2-(f2[0]+f2[2]/2),y=H/2-3-(f2[1]+f2[3]/2);
    g.fillStyle='rgba(0,18,28,.28)';g.beginPath();g.ellipse(W/2,H/2-3+f2[3]*.55+3,f2[2]*.4,2.6,0,0,TAU);g.fill();TurboCity.draw(g,id,x,y,{mode:'runtime',scale:sc,sz:2,variant:0,time:0})}catch(e){er('fishCard',e)}
   g.fillStyle='rgba(223,247,255,.85)';g.font='600 10px Segoe UI,Arial';g.textAlign='left';g.fillText(cm+' ס״מ',5,H-5)})}

 function nameOf(spec){if(!NAMED[spec.type])return null;return NAMES[hash('n|'+(spec.id||spec.type))%NAMES.length]}
 function model(spec){const key=spec.type+'|'+spec.L+'|'+spec.B+'|'+(spec.lvKey||'')+'|'+(spec.cargoLive?1:0)+'|'+(spec.id||'')+'|'+(spec.hatches||0)+'|'+(spec.upKey||'')+'|'+(spec.variant==null?'':spec.variant);let M=MODEL.get(key);if(M)return M;
  const ty=T[spec.type]||T.motor,lv0=spec.lv||ty.lv[hash(spec.id||spec.type)%ty.lv.length],lv=/^(yacht|yachtL|cruiser)$/.test(spec.type)?Object.assign({},lv0,{deck:'#e6e3da'}):lv0,m={type:ty.type,L:spec.L,B:spec.B,shape:ty.shape},b=build(ty.type,spec.L,spec.B,lv,spec);
  {const rk=RAKE[spec.type],mm=spec.L/ty.real[0];if(rk)for(const p of b.P)if(p.k==='box'&&(p.win||p.cabin)&&!p.tp&&!p.ctn){const h=p.z1-p.z0,lx=p.x1-p.x0,ly=p.y1-p.y0,f=rk[0]*h*mm;p.tp=[f>0?Math.min(lx*.32,f):Math.max(-lx*.12,f),Math.min(ly*.18,rk[1]*h*mm),Math.min(lx*.12,rk[2]*h*mm)]}}

 function drawBox(c,o,p,N,lod){const C=[[p.x0,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y1],[p.x0,p.y1]],NR=[[0,-1],[1,0],[0,1],[-1,0]],tp=p.tp,H=p.z1-p.z0;
  const Ct=tp?[[p.x0+tp[2],p.y0+tp[1]],[p.x1-tp[0],p.y0+tp[1]],[p.x1-tp[0],p.y1-tp[1]],[p.x0+tp[2],p.y1-tp[1]]]:C,INS=tp?[tp[1],tp[0],tp[1],tp[2]]:null;
  const W=(i,f)=>{const a=C[i],b=Ct[i];return pj(o,a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*f,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*f,p.z0+H*f)},E=(i,u,f)=>{const A=W(i,f),Q=W((i+1)%4,f);return[A[0]+(Q[0]-A[0])*u,A[1]+(Q[1]-A[1])*u]},
   Q4=(i,u0,u1,f0,f1)=>[E(i,u0,f0),E(i,u1,f0),E(i,u1,f1),E(i,u0,f1)];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const nx=NR[i][0]*o.c-NR[i][1]*o.s,ny=NR[i][0]*o.s+NR[i][1]*o.c;let nz=0,k;
   if(INS){const hp=Math.max(.01,H*10),d=INS[i],nl=Math.hypot(hp,d)||1;nz=d/nl;if(ny*hp/nl+.6*nz<=.015)continue;k=wallK(nx,ny)*(1-Math.abs(nz))+(nz>0?1.06:.6)*Math.abs(nz)}else{if(ny<=.015)continue;k=wallK(nx,ny)}
   const a=C[i],b=C[(i+1)%4];c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,k,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,Q4(i,0,1,0,1));c.fill();
   if(p.ctn&&lod>1){c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.22)';c.lineWidth=.5;c.beginPath();const n=Math.max(2,Math.round(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/3));for(let q=1;q<n;q++){const u=q/n,q0=E(i,u,0),q1=E(i,u,1);c.moveTo(q0[0],q0[1]);c.lineTo(q1[0],q1[1])}c.stroke()}
   if(p.stripe&&lod>0){const sf=p.sf||[.08,.16];c.fillStyle=shade(p.stripe,k,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,Q4(i,0,1,sf[0],sf[1]));c.fill()}
   if(p.win&&lod>0){const len=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]),fA=p.win.big?.3:.42,fB=p.win.big?.88:.8,lit=N>.35,refl=!lit&&lod>1,ra=(.2+.16*Math.max(0,nz)).toFixed(3);

 function paint(c,spec,x,y,h,t,o){o=o||{};try{

  if(!o.noShadow){c.fillStyle='rgba(2,14,28,'+(.24*(1-.45*N)).toFixed(3)+')';c.beginPath();poly(c,out.map(p=>sp(F,p[0],p[1],fb+p[2])));
  for(const p of M.P)if(p.k==='box'&&p.z1>fb+.6){const Q=[];for(const[a,b]of[[p.x0,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y0],[p.x1,p.y1],[p.x0,p.y1]]){Q.push(sp(F,a,b,p.z0),sp(F,a,b,p.z1))}poly(c,hull2d(Q))}c.fill('nonzero')}

    poly(c,[pj(F,a[0]*.97,a[1]*.92,0),pj(F,b[0]*.97,b[1]*.92,0),pj(F,b[0],b[1],-(fb+b[2])*.75),pj(F,a[0],a[1],-(fb+a[2])*.75)])}c.fill();c.restore()}

  const q4=(a,b,f0,f1)=>[RP(a,f0),RP(b,f0),RP(b,f1),RP(a,f1)],
   nrm=(a,b,f0,f1)=>{const A=R(a,f0),Q=R(b,f0),D=R(a,f1),ex=Q[0]-A[0],ey=Q[1]-A[1],dx=D[0]-A[0],dy=D[1]-A[1],dz=(D[2]-A[2])*10;let nx=-ey*dz,ny=ex*dz,nz=ey*dx-ex*dy;const n=Math.hypot(nx,ny,nz)||1;nx/=n;ny/=n;nz/=n;return[nx*F.c-ny*F.s,nx*F.s+ny*F.c,nz]},
   litK=w=>{const hh=Math.hypot(w[0],w[1])||1,az=Math.abs(w[2]);return cl(wallK(w[0]/hh,w[1]/hh)*(1-az)+(w[2]>0?1.06:.56)*az,.5,1.12)};
  const band=(f0,f1,col,k)=>{if(lod===0){c.fillStyle=shade(col,.8*(k||1),N);c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides)if(wy>-.02)poly(c,q4(a,b,f0,f1));c.fill();return}
   for(const[a,b]of sides){const w=nrm(a,b,f0,f1);if(w[1]+.6*w[2]<=-.02)continue;c.fillStyle=shade(col,litK(w)*(k||1),N);c.beginPath();poly(c,q4(a,b,f0,f1));c.fill()}};

   if(SHIPT[spec.type]){const q=pj(F,L*.5*HX,0,-fb*.32);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1],L*.03,B*.13,F.h,0,TAU);c.fill()}c.restore()}

   for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides){if(wy<.12)continue;const p=RP(a,.93),q=RP(b,.93);c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1])}c.stroke();

  if(lod>1&&SHIPT[spec.type]){c.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,'+(.1+.05*N).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=.45;c.beginPath();for(const[a,b,wx,wy]of sides){if(wy<.2)continue;const p=RP(a,.42),q=RP(b,.42),p2=RP(a,.62),q2=RP(b,.62);c.moveTo(p[0],p[1]);c.lineTo(q[0],q[1]);c.moveTo(p2[0],p2[1]);c.lineTo(q2[0],q2[1])}c.stroke();
   for(const sd of[-1,1]){if(sd*F.c<.12)continue;let best=null;for(const a of out)if(a[1]*sd>0&&(!best||Math.abs(a[0]-L*.41)<Math.abs(best[0]-L*.41)))best=a;if(!best)continue;
    const h0=RP(best,.86),a0=RP(best,.8),a1=RP(best,.6),aw=Math.max(.8,B*.03);c.fillStyle=shade('#15191c',1,N);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(h0[0],h0[1],aw*.9,aw*.6,0,0,TAU);c.fill();
    c.fillStyle=shade('#2a2f35',1,N);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a0[0]-aw*.3,a0[1]);c.lineTo(a0[0]+aw*.3,a0[1]);c.lineTo(a1[0]+aw*.9,a1[1]);c.lineTo(a1[0]-aw*.9,a1[1]);c.closePath();c.fill()}}
   
  if(lod>1&&N<.8&&L<300&&-F.s>.15){const nm=spec.name||nameOf(spec);if(nm){const g=gF(.5),lx=-L/2*(HX+(1-HX)*g),q=pj(F,lx-.3,0,fb*.5),wT=B*(M.ty.shape.tr||.8)*(HY+(1-HY)*g)*.74,fs=Math.max(1.2,fb*10*.36),cT=c.getTransform(),scr=fs*KZ/10*Math.hypot(cT.a,cT.b);
   if(scr>=3.2){c.save();c.transform(-F.s,F.c,0,KZ/10,q[0],q[1]);c.font='700 '+fs.toFixed(2)+'px Segoe UI,Arial';const tw=c.measureText(nm).width||1;if(tw>wT)c.scale(wT/tw,1);
   const lum=parseInt((lv.hull||'#ffffff').slice(1,3),16);c.fillStyle=shade(lum>140?'#1d2f45':'#d8b45a',1,N);c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.direction='rtl';c.fillText(nm,0,0);c.restore()}}}

  if(lod>1&&(M.lights.teak||spec.type==='row'||spec.type==='fish'||spec.type==='console'||spec.type==='sport')){c.strokeStyle='rgba(80,60,40,.22)';c.lineWidth=.35;c.beginPath();for(let k=-3;k<=3;k++){const a=pj(F,-L*.46,k*B*.12,fb+.03),b=pj(F,M.lights.teak?-L*.33:L*.3,k*B*.12*(M.lights.teak?1:(1-.2*Math.abs(k)/3)),fb+.03);c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1])}c.stroke()}
  if(lod>1&&L>220){c.fillStyle='rgba(30,36,40,.7)';for(let x=-L*.42;x<L*.4;x+=L*.09)for(const s of[-1,1]){const q=pj(F,x,s*B*.44,fb+.05);c.fillRect(q[0]-1.2,q[1]-1,2.4,2)}}

 function part(c,F,p,M,N,lod,o,spec){const fb=M.fb,L=spec.L,B=spec.B,lv=M.lv;
  switch(p.k){
   case'box':drawBox(c,F,p,N,lod);break;
   case'cyl':drawCyl(c,F,p,N);break;
   case'hcyl':{ 
    const mm=L/M.ty.real[0],rx=p.r*mm,n=14,E=(t,y)=>pj(F,p.x+Math.cos(t)*rx,(p.y||0)+y,p.z+Math.sin(t)*p.r),A=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const t=i/n*TAU;A.push(E(t,-p.w),E(t,p.w))}
    c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,.8,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,hull2d(A));c.fill();
    if(lod>0){c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,1.04,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,[E(1,-p.w),E(2.1,-p.w),E(2.1,p.w),E(1,p.w)]);c.fill()}
    if(lod>1&&p.net){c.strokeStyle=shade(p.net,.7,N);c.lineWidth=.35;c.beginPath();for(const t of[.45,.8,1.25,1.7,2.15,2.6]){const a=E(t,-p.w*.96),b=E(t,p.w*.96);c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1])}c.stroke()}
    const ye=F.c>0?p.w:-p.w,D=[];for(let i=0;i<n;i++)D.push(E(i/n*TAU,ye));c.fillStyle=shade(p.end||p.col,.95,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,D);c.fill();
    if(lod>0){const q=pj(F,p.x,(p.y||0)+ye,p.z);c.fillStyle=shade('#2a2f35',1,N);c.beginPath();c.arc(q[0],q[1],Math.max(.5,rx*.22),0,TAU);c.fill()}break}
   case'flat':{c.fillStyle=shade(p.col,1,N);c.beginPath();poly(c,p.pts.map(q=>pj(F,q[0],q[1],p.z)));c.fill();if(p.line&&lod>1){c.strokeStyle=p.line;c.lineWidth=.6;c.stroke()}break}
   case'mast':{if(lod===0&&p.w<1.2)break;const a=pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z0),b=pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z1);line(c,a,b,Math.max(.5,p.w*.8),shade(p.col,.9,N));
    if(p.yard&&lod>0){const q=p.z0+(p.z1-p.z0)*.62;line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y-p.yard,q),pj(F,p.x,p.y+p.yard,q),.7,shade(p.col,.8,N))}
    if(p.radar&&lod>0){const z=p.z0+(p.z1-p.z0)*.4,an=(o.under||(o.u||0)>3)?F.t*2.6:.6;if(p.dome){const q=pj(F,p.x,p.y,z);c.fillStyle=shade('#f4f6f8',1,N);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q[0],q[1],p.radar*.45,p.radar*.32,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
     else line(c,pj(F,p.x+Math.cos(an)*p.radar,p.y+Math.sin(an)*p.radar,z),pj(F,p.x-Math.cos(an)*p.radar,p.y-Math.sin(an)*p.radar,z),1.2,shade('#2a2f35',1,N))}
    if(p.jib&&lod>0)line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z1-.3),pj(F,p.jib[0],p.jib[1],p.jib[2]),.9,shade(p.col,.85,N));
    if(p.boom&&lod>0)line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z0+.2),pj(F,p.boom[0],p.boom[1],p.boom[2]),p.bw||.7,shade(p.col,.85,N));
    if(lod>1&&p.w<1.6)line(c,pj(F,p.x,p.y,p.z1),pj(F,p.x-L*.02,p.y,p.z1+.9),.35,'rgba(40,44,48,.8)');break}
   case'glass':{ 
    const g0=pj(F,p.x1,p.y0,p.z0),g1=pj(F,p.x1,p.y1,p.z0),g2=pj(F,p.x0,p.y1,p.z1),g3=pj(F,p.x0,p.y0,p.z1),mid=(a,b,u)=>[lerp(a[0],b[0],u),lerp(a[1],b[1],u)];c.fillStyle=N>.4?'rgba(36,54,72,.7)':'rgba(64,98,124,.55)';c.beginPath();poly(c,[g0,g1,g2,g3]);c.fill();
    if(lod>0&&N<=.4){c.fillStyle='rgba(214,232,246,.32)';c.beginPath();poly(c,[mid(g0,g3,.55),mid(g1,g2,.55),g2,g3]);c.fill()}
    if(lod>0){c.strokeStyle=shade('#dfe5ea',1,N);c.lineWidth=Math.max(.45,(spec.B||20)*.012);c.beginPath();poly(c,[g0,g1,g2,g3]);c.stroke()}

   case'motor':{const ku=p.up?1.4:1;for(let i=0;i<p.n;i++){const y=(p.n>1?(i-(p.n-1)/2)*B*(p.up?.3:.32):0),x0=p.x-(p.big?.9:.6)*L/14*ku,x1=p.x+.05*L/14,w=B*(p.big?.11:.08)*(p.up?1.25:1);drawBox(c,F,{x0,x1,y0:y-w,y1:y+w,z0:.15,z1:M.fb+(p.big?.75:.5)*ku,col:p.col||'#2a2f35',top:p.top||'#3a4046',stripe:p.band,sf:p.up?[.5,.72]:null},N,lod);

 function lightsOf(c,F,M,N,o,spec,lod){const Lt=M.lights,L=spec.L,B=spec.B,a=cl(N*1.2,0,1),r=Math.max(5,Math.min(24,L*.05+4)),under=o.under||(o.u||0)>3,refl=(o.anchor==='deck'?0:1);
  const P=v=>pj(F,v[0],v[1],v[2]),ry=v=>(v[2]-F.zr)*KZ*refl;
  if(under){if(Lt.side){const sY=Lt.side[1];lamp(c,...P([Lt.side[0],-sY,Lt.side[2]]),'red',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.side));lamp(c,...P([Lt.side[0],sY,Lt.side[2]]),'green',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.side))}
   if(Lt.mast)lamp(c,...P(Lt.mast),'white',r*.8,a,ry(Lt.mast));if(Lt.fwd)lamp(c,...P(Lt.fwd),'white',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.fwd));if(Lt.stern)lamp(c,...P(Lt.stern),'white',r*.6,a,ry(Lt.stern))}
  else{if(Lt.mast)lamp(c,...P(Lt.mast),'white',r*.5,a*.75,0);else if(Lt.stern)lamp(c,...P(Lt.stern),'white',r*.45,a*.7,0)}
  if(Lt.beacon==='blue'&&under&&(F.t*2.2%1)<.5)lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-.6]),'blue',r,a,0);
  if(Lt.beacon==='pilot'&&Lt.mast){lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-.5]),'white',r*.5,a*.9,0);lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-1.1]),'red',r*.5,a*.9,0)}
  if((Lt.work&&o.fishing)||(L>200&&!under)){const q=Lt.stern?P([Lt.stern[0]+L*.08,0,Lt.stern[2]+1.2]):P([0,0,M.fb+3]);lamp(c,...q,'warm',r*1.6,a*.55,0)}
  if(L>400){for(let x=-L*.3;x<L*.35;x+=L*.16)lamp(c,...P([x,0,M.fb+6]),'warm',r*1.1,a*.35,0)}}
  
 

 const TRL=new Map(),WK=new Map();
 function trailRec(spec,F,o){const now=performance.now(),k=spec.id;let T=TRL.get(k);const sx=F.x-F.c*spec.L*.5,sy=F.y-F.s*spec.L*.5,u=o.u||0;
  if(!T||now-T.t>1000){T={P:[],t:now};TRL.set(k,T);if(TRL.size>80)TRL.delete(TRL.keys().next().value)}T.t=now;T.cur={x:sx,y:sy,L:spec.L,u};
  if(u>3&&(!T.P.length||now-T.P[T.P.length-1].t>=100)){T.P.push({x:sx,y:sy,h:F.h,u,t:now});}const maxAge=Math.min(6,3*spec.L/Math.max(u,1));while(T.P.length&&now-T.P[0].t>maxAge*1000)T.P.shift();if(T.P.length>80)T.P.shift()}
 function wake(c,F,spec,o,lod){const L=spec.L,B=spec.B,u=o.u||0,T=o.trail,k=cl(u/(L>200?30:45),.15,1)*(1-.55*(o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow())),fz=o.anchor==='deck'?F.zr*KZ:0;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
  const sideways=o.vx!=null&&Math.abs(-o.vx*F.s+o.vy*F.c)>Math.abs(o.vx*F.c+o.vy*F.s)*1.2;
  if(sideways){const vn=Math.hypot(o.vx,o.vy)||1,nx=-o.vx/vn,ny=-o.vy/vn;c.fillStyle='rgba(240,250,255,'+(.3*k).toFixed(2)+')';c.beginPath();
   const a=[F.x-F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y-F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz],b=[F.x+F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y+F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz];c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);c.lineTo(b[0]+nx*B*.5,b[1]+ny*B*.5);c.lineTo(a[0]+nx*B*.5,a[1]+ny*B*.5);c.fill();c.restore();return}
  const now=performance.now(),maxAge=Math.min(6,3*L/Math.max(u,1)),stern={x:F.x-F.c*L*.5,y:F.y-F.s*L*.5,h:F.h,u,t:now},P=[stern];if(T)for(let i=T.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=T[i],ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>maxAge)break;P.push(q)}
  if(P.length>1&&Math.hypot(P[1].x-P[0].x,P[1].y-P[0].y)>Math.max(14,u*.2))P.length=1;    
  if(P.length>1){let run=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const d=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);if(run+d>3*L){const f=(3*L-run)/Math.max(1e-6,d);P[i]=Object.assign({},P[i],{x:P[i-1].x+(P[i].x-P[i-1].x)*f,y:P[i-1].y+(P[i].y-P[i-1].y)*f});run=3*L;P.length=i+1;break}run+=d}
   WK.set(spec.id||'?',{L,u:Math.round(u),len:Math.round(run),gap:Math.round(Math.hypot(P[1].x-P[0].x,P[1].y-P[0].y)),t:now});
   for(const side of[1,-1]){let prev=null;for(const q of P){const ag=(now-q.t)/1000,f=ag/maxAge,sp=B*.42+ag*(q.u||u)*.17,sx=-Math.sin(q.h)*side,sy=Math.cos(q.h)*side,pt=[q.x+sx*sp,q.y+sy*sp+fz];
     if(prev){c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.55*(1-f)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,B*.04)+ag*.45;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(prev[0],prev[1]);c.lineTo(pt[0],pt[1]);c.stroke()}prev=pt}}
   for(const q of P){const ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>1.8)break;c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.3*(1-ag/1.8)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q.x,q.y+fz,B*.3+ag*B*.12,B*.2+ag*B*.06,q.h,0,TAU);c.fill()}}
   
  const bx=F.x+F.c*L*.5,by=F.y+F.s*L*.5+fz;for(const side of[1,-1]){const nx=-F.s*side,ny=F.c*side;c.strokeStyle='rgba(250,253,255,'+(.7*k).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.7,B*.05);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(bx,by);
   c.quadraticCurveTo(bx-F.c*L*.1+nx*B*.45,by-F.s*L*.1+ny*B*.45,bx-F.c*L*.26+nx*B*.58,by-F.s*L*.26+ny*B*.58);c.stroke()}
  c.restore()}
  
 function wakeAudit(){const now=performance.now(),rows=[];for(const [id,w] of WK){if(now-w.t>1500)continue;rows.push({id,L:Math.round(w.L),u:w.u,len:w.len,ratio:+(w.len/w.L).toFixed(2),firstGap:w.gap})}
  return{ok:rows.every(r=>r.ratio<=3.001&&r.firstGap<=Math.max(14,r.u*.2)),rows}}
  
 const VEL=new Map();
 function vel(id,x,y,now){let q=VEL.get(id);if(!q||now<q.t||now-q.t>1500){q={x,y,t:now,u:0,vx:0,vy:0};VEL.set(id,q);if(VEL.size>300)VEL.delete(VEL.keys().next().value);return q}
  const dt=(now-q.t)/1000;if(dt>=.04){const vx=(x-q.x)/dt,vy=(y-q.y)/dt;q.vx=lerp(q.vx,vx,.4);q.vy=lerp(q.vy,vy,.4);q.u=Math.hypot(q.vx,q.vy);q.x=x;q.y=y;q.t=now}return q}
  
 const SPR=new Map();
 function still(c,key,spec,x,y,h,t,o,dh,bob){const M=model(spec),z=zoomNow(),q=z<.3?.35:z<.6?.6:z<1.1?1:z<1.8?1.5:z<2.4?2:3,qq=spec.L>500?Math.min(q,1):q,N=o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow(),nb=N>.5?1:0,lod=z<.32?0:z<.8?1:2,
  k=key+'|'+qq+'|'+nb+'|'+lod;let S=SPR.get(k);
  if(!S){const L=spec.L,B=spec.B,ca=Math.abs(Math.cos(h)),sa=Math.abs(Math.sin(h)),ex=L/2*ca+B/2*sa+6,ey=L/2*sa+B/2*ca+6,zr=o.anchor==='deck'?M.fb:0,top=ey+(M.zTop-zr)*KZ+14,bot=ey+zr*KZ+M.fb*KZ+M.zTop*SY+14,lef=ex+10,rig=ex+M.zTop*SX+14;
   const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.ceil((lef+rig)*qq);cv.height=Math.ceil((top+bot)*qq);const g=cv.getContext('2d');g.scale(qq,qq);
   paint(g,spec,lef,top,h,0,Object.assign({},o,{u:0,under:false,lod,night:nb?1:0,ph:0,wave:0}));S={cv,lef,top,w:lef+rig,h:top+bot};SPR.set(k,S);
   if(SPR.size>160){const k0=SPR.keys().next().value,o0=SPR.get(k0);SPR.delete(k0);try{o0.cv.width=0}catch(e){}}}
  if(dh){c.save();c.translate(x,y+(bob||0));c.rotate(dh);c.drawImage(S.cv,-S.lef,-S.top,S.w,S.h);c.restore()}else c.drawImage(S.cv,x-S.lef,y-S.top+(bob||0),S.w,S.h);
  if(N>.2&&nb===0)0;return S}
  
 const ASSET={'SH-MB-01':'motor','SH-SP-01':'speed','SH-RB-01':'rent','SH-YT-01':'yacht','SH-PB-01':'cruiser','SH-FB-01':'fish','SH-YT-02':'yachtL','SH-TG-01':'tug','SH-TR-01':'trawl','SH-FY-01':'ferry','SH-CS-01':'container','SH-BK-01':'bulk'};
 const BEAM={motor:.34,speed:.34,rent:.4,yacht:.27,cruiser:.3,fish:.33,yachtL:.24,tug:.36,trawl:.27,ferry:.2,container:.17,bulk:.17};

var WEATHER=(function(){
 const SEG=3,BLEND=1.5,KINDS=['clear','cloudy','rain','wind'],HE={clear:'בהיר',cloudy:'מעונן',rain:'גשום',wind:'סוער — רוח חזקה'},
  W={summer:{clear:.62,cloudy:.22,rain:.04,wind:.12},winter:{clear:.3,cloudy:.3,rain:.25,wind:.15}},
  WIND={clear:[4,10],cloudy:[7,14],rain:[12,22],wind:[20,32]},CLOUD={clear:.08,cloudy:.7,rain:.95,wind:.45},RAIN={clear:0,cloudy:0,rain:1,wind:.15};
 const ST={seed:20261108,override:null};
 const rnd=(a,b)=>{let h=Math.imul(ST.seed^Math.imul(a+1,2654435761),1597334677)^Math.imul(b+7,374761393);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>15),2246822507);h=Math.imul(h^(h>>>13),3266489909);return((h^(h>>>16))>>>0)/4294967296};
 const season=()=>(+window.__TC_WINTER||0)>.5?'winter':'summer';
 function pick(i,sea){const w=W[sea],r=rnd(i,1);let acc=0;for(const k of KINDS){acc+=w[k];if(r<acc)return k}return'clear'}
 function slot(i,sea){const kind=ST.override||pick(i,sea),[a,b]=WIND[kind],wind=a+(b-a)*rnd(i,2),dir=rnd(Math.floor(i/4),3)*Math.PI*2+(rnd(i,4)-.5)*.8;return{kind,wind,dir,cloud:CLOUD[kind],rain:RAIN[kind]}}
  
 function atAbs(H,sea){sea=sea||season();const i=Math.floor(H/SEG),f=(H-i*SEG)/SEG,cur=slot(i,sea),prev=slot(i-1,sea),u=Math.min(1,f*SEG/BLEND),e=u*u*(3-2*u),mix=(a,b)=>a+(b-a)*e;
  let d=cur.dir-prev.dir;d=Math.atan2(Math.sin(d),Math.cos(d));
  return{kind:e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind,next:cur.kind,from:prev.kind,t:+e.toFixed(3),wind:+mix(prev.wind,cur.wind).toFixed(1),dir:prev.dir+d*e,cloud:+mix(prev.cloud,cur.cloud).toFixed(2),rain:+mix(prev.rain,cur.rain).toFixed(2),season:sea,he:HE[e<.5?prev.kind:cur.kind],slot:i,seed:ST.seed}}

function wldClamp(v,a,b){return v<a?a:v>b?b:v}
function wldSmooth(u){u=wldClamp(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)}

function wldSkyAt(min,sea){const S=wldSun(sea),R=S.rise,T=S.set,m=((min%1440)+1440)%1440;let night=0,warm=0,phase='day';

 if(m>=T-100&&m<T-10)warm=wldSmooth((m-(T-100))/90);else if(m>=T-10&&m<T+45)warm=1-wldSmooth((m-(T-10))/55);
 else if(m>=R-35&&m<R+5)warm=wldSmooth((m-(R-35))/40)*.85;else if(m>=R+5&&m<R+70)warm=.85*(1-wldSmooth((m-(R+5))/65));
 if(m>=T-60&&m<T)phase='sunset';else if(m>=T&&m<T+45)phase='dusk';else if(m>=T+45||m<R-45)phase='night';else if(m>=R-45&&m<R+40)phase='dawn';
 return{night:+night.toFixed(4),warm:+warm.toFixed(4),phase,he:WLD_HE[phase],rise:R,set:T,min:m}}

function lnTPath(sa,s0,sb,s1){if(sa===sb&&s1>=s0)return lnTSlice(sa,s0,s1);const ks=lnTChain(sa,sb);if(!ks)return null;let P=lnTSlice(sa,s0,lnTSeg(sa).total);for(const k of ks.slice(1,-1))P=P.concat(lnTSlice(k,0,lnTSeg(k).total));return P.concat(lnTSlice(sb,0,s1))}
